name: TUR Staking
rootCause: A BNB Chain staking contract branded as TUR Staking was exploited on 2026-03-26 after it calculated staking power from manipulable AMM spot prices. The attacker reportedly inflated the TUR price in TUR-NOBEL and NOBEL-USDT pools, staked during the manipulated window, and extracted amplified referral rewards worth about $133,000. The staking contract derived staking power and referral rewards from live AMM reserve ratios read through spot pricing instead of a manipulation-resistant oracle or TWAP. Reported analysis also indicates the referral reward accounting granted additional reward power to referrer accounts without corresponding reward-debt adjustm…
